newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: PGMs start slightly firmer in Europe.
newsitem.headline: PGMs start slightly firmer in Europe.

text.p: Platinum and palladium opened slightly firmer, but early trading in Europe was quiet.
The market shrugged off the latest comments by Russian export agency Almaz that exports would be resumed at the "nearest" possible time.
"It's been the same story for months," said one dealer.
Platinum opened slightly firmer at $450.00/455.00 compared with its previous London close of $440.10/445.10.
Palladium was also firmer at $210.00/215.00 compared with $205.60/210.60.
Gold, however, remained steady and opened at $343.20/343.50 from London's $343.50/344.00 and New York's $343.70/344.20.
Dealers see gold holding above $340 in the next few days, but in the medium term it could ease as the market licks its wounds from the platinum debacle.
Silver opened easier, but essentially steady at 475/477 cents compared with 477/479.
